Lambson family · Person

Norma Lucille Lambson

1923–2000

Open in the family tree

Names in the records
Norma Lucille Jameson Lambson (variant in supplied research), Norma Lucille Lambson Downard
Born
April 18, 1923 · Bingham Canyon, Utah
Died
October 23, 2000

Born in Bingham Canyon. In 1942, she married Thomas John Downard in Salt Lake City, joining the two family lines.

Norma’s 1942 marriage joined the Lambson and Downard branches. The family record gives June 26 and the supplied newspaper summary gives June 30. Robert, Glen and Quinn are listed as their children.

Family connections

Parents Glenn Cody Lambson, Mary Lucille Jamieson Lambson Pedersen

Grandparents Arba Lorenzo Lambson Jr., Rosella Francenia Blanchard

Spouses and partners Thomas John Downard

Children with Thomas John Downard: Glen L. Downard, Quinn C. Downard, Robert T. Downard
